status: Complete: corrected DPR1/DPR2 zoom, layout, phase/pan,224 pixel views, automated/release checks, and browser/full-production-board verification.
baselineDescription: Previous coverage-tile renderer with its original coverage font metadata and PNG loaded from the same Git revision.
currentDescription: Fused Gaussian, pixel-box, and cubic B-spline glyph coverage; retained spatial glyph bins; discard only exactly zero coverage; positive four-offset MSDF reconstruction at8–12 physical em; no object coverage tiles in the default path.
notes: No input document content or private input file path is included.
Sample rows map positionally to the columns array. All recorded frame sample fields are retained.
Per-block resource deltas omit frame-local reset counters; per-frame glyph and draw counts remain in samples.
Selected render DPR is 2; backing canvases are2400×1600. Browser devicePixelRatio is separately reported by visibility snapshots.
Both renderers share warmed current viewport layout during GPU comparison. Separate layout evidence compares historical and indexed layout implementations.
Cold and repeat identify cache state, not shader/font loading. GPU and CPU measurements are not interchangeable with rAF scheduling.
At DPR2, lower p95, mean, and maximum zoom GPU times coexist with a higher median. No universal FPS or warm-pan improvement is claimed.
DPR1 repeated-zoom GPU mean rises from3.687953 to4.792218ms while p95 falls from15.902708 to12.962875ms. The final implementation does not improve every GPU aggregate.
